capabilities: Open .py files in a dedicated read-only view
Show a structure outline of imports, classes, functions, methods, and constants
Filter symbols and source lines by name, kind, detail, and text
Jump from a symbol to its source line
Report parse diagnostics while keeping the source view available
disambiguation: Not an IDE or code runner; it never executes Python code, edits, lints, formats, or refactors files.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README states it makes no network requests, writes no files, and renders only the first 10,000 lines of large generated scripts.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to inspect Python files stored in a vault without opening an external editor or IDE.

relations.evidence: For beta testing, install the plugin with BRAT using this repository URL

summary: Read-only viewer for .py files with a structure outline, syntax-highlighted source view, symbol filtering, and parse diagnostics.
